test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A sum of Rs. 6,300 amounts to Rs. 8,085 at a certain rate percent p.a. in 3{ {1} over 3} years, at simple interest. What will be the simple interest (in Rs.) on a sum of Rs. 8,000 at the same rate for 4{ {2} over 5} years?
solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 6300

Amount = Rs. 8085

Time = 3{ {1} over 3} years

**Concept used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

S.I = Amount - P

Here,

P = Sum or principal

T = time

R = rate

**Calculation:**

Interest = 8085 - 6300

⇒ Rs. 1785

Let the rate be r

Now,

1785 = [(6300 × 10 × r)/(100 × 3)]

⇒ 1785 = 210r

⇒ r = 1785/210

⇒ r = 8.5

So, rate = 8.5%

Now,

S.I = [(8000 × 22 × 8.5)/(100 × 5)]

⇒ S.I = 2992

**∴ Required simple interest will be Rs. 2992.**
